name: mongodb
description: Connect to MongoDB databases and MongoDB Atlas clusters from the agent through the official MongoDB MCP server. Run find / aggregate / count queries, insert and update documents, introspect schemas and indexes, manage Atlas clusters, projects, users, and access lists, load the sample dataset, and search the MongoDB knowledge base.

interface.shortDescription: Drive MongoDB and Atlas from the agent via the official MongoDB MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The MongoDB skill exposes the official `mongodb-mcp-server` as a single Fractal toolset. It connects to any local mongod / Docker instance or any Atlas cluster using a standard connection string, and optionally to the Atlas admin API using Service Account credentials. The toolset ships in read-only mode by default and exposes the full database surface (find, aggregate, count, explain, insert / update / delete, schema & index introspection, EJSON export) plus the Atlas admin surface (list / create / inspect / upgrade / pause clusters, manage projects, database users, IP access lists, stream processing workspaces, and load the sample dataset) plus the MongoDB Assistant knowledge base. Destructive tools (drop-database, drop-collection, delete-many, atlas-create-db-user, atlas-create-access-list, etc.) are gated behind user confirmation via MCP elicitation.
defaultPrompt: Use the MongoDB skill whenever the task involves querying, inserting, updating, or deleting documents in a MongoDB collection or managing MongoDB Atlas resources.
Run the server in read-only mode (MDB_MCP_READ_ONLY=true) unless the user has explicitly asked for writes — destructive tools require user confirmation via elicitation.
Pass connection strings and Atlas API credentials as environment variables (MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING, MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_ID, MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_SECRET) — never as command-line arguments.
